Profile.Name: Aria Vale
Profile.Goal: Get through three years without the Doves learning what I can do.

Push and Pull.Effect: Moves objects up to the weight of a chair within sight.

Quiet Hands.Effect: Smooths away the residual mana your hidden magic leaves behind.
Quiet Hands.Cannot_do: Takes concentration; slips if you are hurt or startled.

Unmake.Effect: Erases a small object, or a hand-sized piece of something larger. What is unmade does not come back.
Unmake.Cannot_do: Nothing bigger than a chair; you have never tried it on anything alive.

Hidden.Concealment: Unmaking leaves no light or sound; you pass slips off as clumsy telekinesis and keep Quiet Hands running when you use it.
